# mybone.health

> Patient-focused osteoporosis and bone health guidance from Lisa Pocius, MD, a physician-author who lives with the condition.

Lisa Pocius, MD is a board-certified family medicine physician. After vertebral compression fractures and an osteoporosis diagnosis, she wrote the patient guide she wishes she had on day one. Every clinical claim on this site is traced to a primary source: the FDA label, the trial publication, or the guideline document. Medication articles carry a review date and name her as the reviewer.

## Book

- [Osteoporosis: The Book I Wish I'd Had When I Was Diagnosed](https://mybone.health/): June 2026 patient guide (paperback ISBN 979-8-9955646-0-7, hardcover ISBN 979-8-9955646-2-1, ebook ISBN 979-8-9955646-1-4)
- Paperback: https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0H3P1JFK4
